questions.question: For an M998-series HMMWV, what engine symptom calls for checking the air-intake/exhaust system, and is a 0.20-inch dust-unloader center opening acceptable?
For an M998-series HMMWV, what engine issue calls for checking the air-intake/exhaust system, and is a 0.20-inch dust-unloader center opening acceptable under the stated PMCS limit?
For an M998-series HMMWV that fails to develop full engine power, should the air-intake/exhaust system be checked, and is a 0.20-inch dust-unloader center opening within the stated PMCS limit?

claims.text: Failure to develop full engine power is a stated reason to check the air-intake/exhaust system under standard maintenance procedures for HMMWV (M998-series) vehicles, as commonly outlined in vehicle maintenance manuals including TM 9-2320-280-20-1.
A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch is below the PMCS (Preventive Maintenance Control System) limit.
The PMCS limit for the dust-unloader center opening is typically 0.25 inches.
A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch is within acceptable limits.
A dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch does not indicate a failure.
